annotations.title: Status of a prepaid balance appraisal purchase

description: RAIL: PREPAID BALANCE. Receipt reader for purchase_appraisal only, keyed by operationId on the same authenticated agent connection. Read the original purchase-1 receipt. This does not start or resume delivery and cannot create a purchase. A pending receipt gives retryAfterSeconds; after that delay, recover with purchase_appraisal using the SAME operationId and original arguments. A refunded receipt means service credits returned to the account. Not for the other rails: a human-card checkout order is read with appraisal_order_status (orderId + orderToken); an enrolled-card charge is read with appraisal_card_order_status (operationId).

operationId.description: Caller-chosen purchase identifier. Persist it before calling and reuse it with the original arguments after a lost reply; never generate a new identifier for a retry.

name: appraisal_purchase_status
